propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters must be blocked at plan-review gate before any LLM call with coverage.llm_ran=false.
Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters must be blocked at completion-verification gate before any runner call with deterministic FAIL.
The maximum-description setting must be configurable via [verify] configuration with default 8,000 characters and enforce exactly 8,000 allowed while 8,001 blocks.
Light-bug plan-review path must partition DET blocks by retaining only P4 description findings as blocking while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory.
Completion verification must check authoritative ticket description immediately after config load and before child checks or context assembly.
Neither gate shall truncate or summarize oversized ticket content; force lifecycle command remains the operator override.
